title: Rule #1: Always Assume Loaded
body:
🔥🛡️ Heard that GAFC fam talkin' 'bout real responsibility? Let's get into it.

Gloxsie 21 caught Bobo Licious almost doing the 'oopsie daisy' with his new piece the other day. Bobo was showing off, just forgot to check if it was clear before he started pointing it around. 🤦‍♂️

Gloxsie, cool as always, stepped in smooth: "Hold up, fam! Rule #1: ALWAYS assume it's loaded. Every time. No exceptions. We ain't playing games with safety; we're building a legacy here." Bobo, ever the quick learner (after a lil' embarrassment), got right with the program.

See, it ain't about fear; it's about respect. Respect for yourself, your family, and your community. Just like Pastor Jenkins at Church of Legacy reminds us, wisdom and discipline gotta guide every move we make, whether it's in faith or safeguarding our homes.

GAFC is about empowering us to protect what's ours, legally and responsibly. That means knowing your tools, practicing safety like it's second nature, and teaching the next gen right. It's self-reliance, not recklessness.

What's ONE gun safety rule YOU live by? Drop it in the comments! Let's share the wisdom and keep our streets safe and strong.

#GAFC #GunSafetyEducation #CommunityFirst #LegalGunOwnership #Empowerment #BlackAndBrownOwned #SelfReliance #LegacyBuilders
